QuestInfo.name: Reach for the Wise Man's Star!
QuestInfo.0: The #bWise Man's Star#k has shown itself in the sky! Its powerful energies are streaming across Maple World even now, and the Maple Administrator has hinted at an opportunity for #bMagicians between level 120 and 195#k from this!\r\nSee the Maple Administrator.
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Administrator told you that if you gain 5 levels under the Wise Man's Star, you can receive an EXP Buff Item and an Attack Scroll. Return to her when you have gained your levels.
